# Safe Hands Safety (Safe Hand EHS Consulting, Inc.)

> Leading safety implementation partner for pipeline operators and energy contractors across the Permian Basin and United States. Specializing in DOT 49 CFR 192/195 Operator Qualification (OQ), NCCER certifications, OSHA 10/30, Basin United, and DOT drug testing.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [DOT (OQ) PHMSA Compliance](https://www.safehandssafety.com/services/oq-phmsa): Proctored operator qualification evaluations across 6 major platforms (Veriforce, EWN, NCCER, ITS, MEA EnergyU, OQSG 5Keys) covering 600+ covered tasks for pipeline and hazardous liquid infrastructure.
- [Workforce & Heavy Equipment Certification](https://www.safehandssafety.com/services/workforce-equipment): NCCER accredited practical and written examinations for mobile cranes, rigging/signalperson, aerial work platforms (MEWP), and industrial forklifts.
- [Safety Training & Orientation](https://www.safehandssafety.com/services/safety-training): SafeLand 7.0, Basin United 2-Day orientations, and OSHA 10/30-Hour general industry and construction outreach cards.
- [Occupational Health & Medical Screening](https://www.safehandssafety.com/services/health-medical): DOT FMCSA compliant rapid urine drug screening, evidential breath alcohol testing (BAT), audiometric surveillance, and respirator fit testing.
- [Midstream Safety Inspectors](https://www.safehandssafety.com/services/midstream-inspectors): Certified AWS/CWI weld inspectors, NACE/AMPP coating inspectors, and chief utility safety inspection teams.

## Audit Defensibility & Accreditation

All evaluations, exams, and drug screens comply with federal safety standards (DOT 49 CFR 192/195, OSHA 1910/1926) and are registered immediately into third-party verification platforms (Veriforce, ISNetworld, EWN, NCCER registry).
